review: There is no Norwegian on this site. There is Swedish, which I can read perfectly well, and I suspect nobody has considered that a Norwegian would take it. "Den långa vägen hem" — the long way home. I am four weeks on and four weeks off and I have listened to this on eleven consecutive night watches at 0300 in the North Sea, which I find absurd and have not stopped doing. My father died when I was fourteen and the pastor said something at the funeral so obviously untrue that it ended the whole thing for me. I am not looking for that to be repaired. I would take one sentence about God that was not insulting to my intelligence. This album is eleven of them.
